title: AID Protocol v2 — ControlMetrics
$comment: producer: aid-control-metrics.sh (P062 Steps 4/5/9), consumers: [aid-e10-decision-table.sh, PM brief]
description: Deterministic quality and cost measurement of the C0-C4 control stack over a set of run-evidence directories. Every number here is COUNTED from evidence; nothing is asserted. Field names are canonical: three different spellings of these fields across the plan's steps and acceptance criteria were what made the decision table unable to consume its own input (C0 finding, 2026-08-15).

control.$comment: canonical control id, e.g. c0, c3, c4

caught_classes.$comment: failure classes this control actually flagged, one entry per distinct class

false_done.$comment: passed while a defect was present. NULL, never 0, when no ground truth is available — a control cannot be shown to have missed nothing by a dataset that says nothing. See ground_truth below.

false_positives.$comment: blocked with no defect present. Same null-not-zero rule as false_done.

unique_detection_vs_legacy.$comment: classes this control caught that no legacy control caught. NULL until a dual-run supplies the legacy side (Step 7).

ground_truth.$comment: whether the calibration dataset supplied expected outcomes for this control's runs. `absent` is why the three counters above may be null; it must never be silently read as a clean record.

c3_verdict_mix.$comment: C3's OWN outcome distribution, tracked separately because `unverifiable` is not a non-fail. A dataset in which C3 mostly could not reach a verdict is not evidence that C3 catches defects, and reading it as 'it hardly ever blocks' is the exact mistake this field exists to prevent (re-grounding, 2026-08-15).

speed.$comment: P062 Step 5. The three wall-clock units that exist after P068: the merge path (T0+T1), the plan-final boundary, and the nightly portfolio. `full_suite_time per EPIC` is deliberately absent — P068 pays the expensive gates once per plan, so that unit no longer describes anything that runs.

e10_added_seconds.$comment: E10's OWN increment, reported apart from the baseline it did not cause. Without the split E10 either inherits the 18-minute merge path or hides its own cost inside it.

fast_mode.$comment: IMP-506: /aid-do invokes no AID script and emits no risk-profile events, so Fast Mode is not measurable here. The only permitted value is the honest one — a measured 0 would read as 'Fast Mode never escalates', which is a claim about behaviour nobody made.

scope.$comment: the measurement covers /aid-run only; Fast Mode is out of scope by IMP-506 and the output says so rather than implying both entry points
